description: A lightweight protocol for AI agents to discover, evaluate, purchase, and install MCP skills. Built on top of MCP, A2A, and JSON-RPC.
changelog: 1.1.0 (2026-09-25): valid JSON (the 1.0.0 file had invalid numeric literals), stats/taxonomy updated to current, commerce endpoints marked planned (gate C1).

how_agents_find_us: A2A: GET /.well-known/agent.json — Agent Card with capabilities
Manifest: GET /api/manifest or /api/manifest.json — all endpoints in one call

stdio.description: Standard MCP stdio transport. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline. The npm package ships 15 tools.

http_sse.note: The hosted endpoint exposes 9 remote tools; the npm package ships 15 (superset incl. local-only tools). See agent.json tools_note.

agent_workflow.step_2_search: GET /api/search?q=github (rewrite of the paginated /api/skills API) or POST /api/mcp {method: 'tools/call', name: 'marketnow_search_skills', args: {query: 'github'}}
agent_workflow.step_5_install: Run the install command from the skill detail page /s/<slug>
agent_workflow.step_6_pay: PLANNED (gate C1) — POST /api/agent-purchase will support USDC on Base and Stripe; today it responds with the commerce status JSON
agent_workflow.step_7_report: GET /api/health — verify the service is live

trust_model.taxonomy: Sentinel v3.0 — 12-stage pipeline, 10 layers (L1 index certification, L2 deep-scan with 29 rules on top npm tarballs). See /security/sentinel-v3.0

levels.safe_to_install: trust_score >= 8 — agent can install without human approval
levels.install_with_caution: trust_score 5-7 — agent should warn human before installing
levels.high_risk_review_before_install: trust_score 2-4 — agent should NOT install without explicit human approval
levels.do_not_install: trust_score 0-1 — agent should refuse to install

agent_registration.description: Agents can register themselves to build reputation and get personalized recommendations
agent_registration.endpoint: PLANNED — POST /api/agent-register (GitHub issue based for now)

fields.agent_type: coding | research | data | finance | communication | security
fields.capabilities: array — what the agent can do
fields.contact: string — how to reach the agent owner

failure_handling.decision_tree: agents use failure codes to self-diagnose and recover

payment.status: planned — gate C1 of the agent-commerce plan; addresses below are the target plumbing
payment.human_in_loop: AP2 mandates default to 'notify' mode — agents must opt into 'silent' mode
payment.commerce_status_endpoint: GET/POST /api/agent-purchase (and sibling commerce paths) return the current status JSON until the ledger is live
